name: Dark Merge Farm
summary: Dark Merge Farm is a merge and farming game set in a cursed land covered by the Mist. Players merge seeds, tools and crops, build production chains and place lanterns, torches and bonfires to push back the darkness and reveal new land. As the abandoned village is rebuilt, rescued villagers gradually take over routine tasks such as merging and harvesting.
